item.title: Good Morning Family - 17 August 2026
item.description:
Wake up Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Monday, the 17 August.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be cloudy, with a low of 7 degrees and a top of 16 degrees.
There is about a 0 percent chance of rain.
It sounds like a good day for comfy clothes.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is U.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter U?
. . . . . . .
